items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Can you tell a little bit about Tony Jackson? No. Very good musician.

ctx.x: He looked like a Mexican. Oh, he didn't be part English. Very nice fellow. And when I saw, I was surprised to see it, because when I saw her, when I left school, I lost track of Lizzie. Lizzie was thin. And when I saw that TV, you can tell her when I saw that TV, I didn't know that was on until I didn't recognize Lizzie. I said, well, Liz is my old school mate right there. Lizzie. Can you tell a little bit about Tony Jackson? No. Very good musician. I'll never forget it was on a Saturday night.
Tony Jackson sold Pretty Baby for $50 on a Saturday night.
